com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Approve one reviewed invoice after required checks and approval steps. Approval can queue a bill in a connected accounting system when automatic export is enabled. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes. Preview only; nothing is applied until you confirm.
examples: Preview approving the invoice we reviewed, with the note: Compared with source. Show remaining blockers and whether approval can queue a bill in our accounting system through automatic export. Wait for my confirmation.

description: Prepare approval of one reviewed invoice. Requires confirmation, current approval authority, no blocking validation errors and cleared approval workflows. name: preview_approve_invoice
title: Preview: Approve an invoice
